name: Stillpoint Neural Meditation & Cognitive Wellness
description: Stillpoint operates a network of neural meditation centers offering BCI-assisted guided meditation, cognitive defragmentation sessions, and what the centers call 'signal hygiene' — structured protocols for clearing the accumulated noise of constant feed exposure, advertising overlays, and involuntary BCI data collection. Sessions range from thirty-minute drop-in decompression pods to multi-day residential cognitive retreats for Tier 4-5 clients experiencing burnout. The centers employ a hybrid staff of licensed neural therapists and traditional mindfulness practitioners from various global lineages, and deliberately use no Axiom or HelixCorp infrastructure.
story_hooks: A Stillpoint client in a deep defragmentation session begins surfacing memories she has no explanation for — fragments of another person's life that seem to have been accidentally written into her BCI during a routine corporate firmware update
A Tier 5 executive books a residential retreat under a false identity; the staff know who she is, and various parties want to know what she's trying to forget
A Stillpoint neural therapist discovers a consistent anomaly in clients who all work for the same corponation subsidiary — something is being systematically suppressed in their BCI logs
